leadText: Pokémon Adventures 20th Anniversary Illustration Book: The Art of Pokémon Adventures (Japanese: Pocket Monsters SPECIAL Satoshi Yamamoto Art Book: The Art of Pocket Monsters SP) is an art book featuring illustrations by Satoshi Yamamoto for the Pokémon Adventures . It is 172 pages long, including an index and the first chapter of the Pokémon Ranger the Comic: Double Mission .
